analyst.text: Miami are on a high after three straight wins and top their NBA Cup group, with Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo each scoring 37 against Cleveland on Friday. They are on a back-to-back, though, and Klay Thompson (ankle) is questionable after missing his first game as a Heat player. Detroit are rested and flew in without trouble, two days after Cade Cunningham's career-high 52 in a double-overtime win at Washington. Miami have the emotional momentum and Detroit have the freshness, which leaves this close to neutral with a slight edge to Detroit.
